order.description: Lookup order for hostnames — 'files' (search /etc/hosts first), 'bind' (DNS first), or combinations like 'files,bind' or 'bind,files'.

multi.description: Allow multiple IP addresses per hostname in /etc/hosts. If false, only the first IP is used.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a DNS response before retrying or moving to the next resolver.

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed DNS query before giving up.

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation. Requires a DNSSEC-aware resolver and network support. Not effective with legacy libc.

ip4_first.description: Prefer IPv4 addresses over IPv6 in dual-stack lookups. Only needed if IPv6 is misconfigured.
